verdict.rationale: Anytype supports Web Publishing to turn any Object into a static webpage at a personal subdomain (.any.org), which can preserve links between published objects and includes custom icon/cover — enabling a basic digital-garden style site without leaving the app. However, evidence doesn't confirm bulk/batch publishing of a curated set of notes as one cohesive site, custom domains, navigation/index pages, or that internal links between unpublished and published notes resolve correctly as a 'browsable' garden. missing for 10: evidence of publishing multiple linked notes as a cohesive browsable site, index/navigation between published pages, custom domain support, and independent/hands-on confirmation of link behavior across published pages.
